title: Exotic Smoky Egyptian Chicken Stew
description: A briny and snappy one-pot Egyptian dish featuring Thai holy basil krapao, with a smoky and spicy flavor, low in sodium, this stew is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the chopped Thai holy basil krapao, smoked paprika, and cumin to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant
Add the chicken broth, diced tomatoes, and salt-free seasoning blend to the pot, stirring to combine
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional chopped Thai holy basil krapao if desired
